title: JOJO OF MC
description: A jojo textures.Such as the stone is Kira,lava is Trish.
body: is is a resource pack based on JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. Once you activate this texture pack, grass blocks will be replaced with Giorno Giovanna’s design, regular stone turns into Yoshikage Kira, deepslate features motifs of Stardust Crusaders, and diorite is themed after Diavolo. This pack is an ideal pick for players fond of female characters from JoJo. Still lava blocks are retextured as Trish Una, and raw stone uses the appearance of Jolyne Cujoh.
